purpose: Canonical tracker for unavoidable Owner-only manual actions. AI must minimize these and recheck immediately after Owner completion.

actions.title: Protect main with an active GitHub branch ruleset
actions.reason_owner_only: The connected GitHub tool can read rulesets/branch protection but does not expose repository-administration write actions for creating them.

target_configuration.note: Do not require manual review approval or signed commits: current automation uses unsigned GitHub Actions/connector commits. After protection is active, AI changes use branch -> PR -> required CI -> merge, so Owner approval is not needed for every normal Beta change.

actions.completion_evidence: GitHub rulesets API shows an Active ruleset targeting main/default branch with required checks authority + continuity and force-push/deletion protection.
actions.after_owner_completion: AI rechecks ruleset and updates this action to PASS.
